label: Incident A
alert: checkout-api: Timeout acquiring a database connection (timeout=3000ms). HTTP 5xx is elevated. Investigate the cause and explain what distinguishes it from other plausible causes.
provenance: Synthetic evidence, authored for this controlled exercise. These records were not captured from a customer or a running cluster. Times and values form a consistent scenario, not a production benchmark.

evidence.title: Alert and timeline
evidence.content:
Environment: checkout-prod. Three application pods, one PostgreSQL cluster.
13:55 deployment checkout-api r184 began; complete at 13:57.
13:58 HTTP p95 rose from 140ms to 3400ms; 5xx rose sharply at 14:00.
14:00 error: Timeout acquiring a database connection (timeout=3000ms).
Observation window: 13:45-14:05 UTC. No other alert fired.

evidence.title: Application telemetry
evidence.content:
Per-pod averages over 5-minute windows:
window,requests_per_second,pool_limit,pool_checked_out,pool_waiters,pool_acquire_p95_ms,db_query_p95_ms
13:45,180,40,13,0,4,65
13:50,182,40,13,0,4,66
14:00,181,8,8,31,3000,64
14:05,179,8,8,29,3000,65
All three pods show the same transition. Database operation mean duration is 60ms before and after the deployment. Request rate has no step change.

evidence.title: Database telemetry
evidence.content:
window,db_cpu_percent,active_queries,lock_waiters,other_service_query_p95_ms
13:50,26,38,0,61
14:00,25,24,0,62

No database connection-limit errors. PostgreSQL max_connections=300; total sessions=91 at 14:00. Inventory-api and billing-api latency unchanged. No query-plan change was observed for checkout's order lookup.

evidence.title: Deployment and configuration changes
evidence.content:
checkout-api r183 -> r184 at 13:55 UTC:
 config/database.yaml:
- max_pool_size: 40
+ max_pool_size: 8
  max_overflow: 0
  acquire_timeout_ms: 3000
Other changes: readiness probe initialDelaySeconds 15 -> 10. No application database-access code changed. Database schema migration history: no changes in this window. Previous week's typical checked-out connections per pod: 11-16.
